plan.summary: Redesign the Projeler create/edit modal (client-only; param_mapping is opaque JSON server-side so no backend change): (1) two-column layout — left = name/description/target lists, right = send config; (2) WhatsApp channel dropdown drops the (account) code; (3) message-type buttons = Onaylı Şablon leftmost + default-selected, Düz Metin disabled, Yok removed; (4) selected template renders as a WhatsApp-style preview bubble (header/body/footer/buttons, {{...}} highlighted) instead of flat text; (5) every {{...}} placeholder (header + body, incl. ones cxapi omits from requiredInputs like hname) gets its own row with a list-COLUMN dropdown — the operator maps each param to a data-list column (name/surname/email/field1..5/tags/note) for per-recipient personalization at send (PR-4).
plan.q_intent: Q (with two screenshots) asked: split popup into two columns (left: name/desc/list; right: rest); drop the code in parens next to channel name; Onaylı Şablon leftmost+default, Düz Metin disabled, remove Yok; show the selected template as the WhatsApp-style preview image; one field per parameter (hname AND name) with a dropdown to choose which list column fills it.

(2) param value = list-column dropdown only (per-recipient); placeholders extracted from ALL header+body {{...}} (cxapi requiredInputs omits header params). verification_questions.question: Is this change client-only and safe server-side — i.e., the new param_mapping entry shape ({paramKey,location,source:'column',column} for text, {kind:'media',...,value:url} for media) is accepted because BuildSendConfig validates param_mapping as opaque JSON (object/array + <=16KB), not entry fields?

Does the save path correctly make the template OPTIONAL — templateKind defaults to 'wapcrm_template' but with no waTemplateId the send-config block is omitted (metadata-only project, server leaves config unchanged), while a picked template requires a column for every {{...}} placeholder and a URL for every media input?

Are placeholders derived from the rendered preview (header.text + body + footer {{...}}) so header params cxapi omits from requiredInputs (e.g. hname) still get a field, and is the JSX free of null-forgiving operators and runtime-throw risks (optional chaining + guards on preview/buttons)?

On edit re-populate, are stored param_mapping rows mapped back correctly (text rows -> paramColumns by paramKey via `column`; media rows -> mediaValues by location:mediaType via `value`) without depending on async template-load order?

error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: No swallowed errors. The metadata-only path (no template) intentionally omits the config block — this is explicit Q-approved behavior, surfaced by the buttons/labels, not a silent default. aha_moments.user_pain: Operators saw a flat-text template preview and a single generic 'Değer' box — no sense of what the message looks like or which placeholders exist.
aha_moments.suggestion: Render an actual WhatsApp-style bubble with the variables highlighted + one labelled row per placeholder.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Operator sees the message exactly as the recipient will, and immediately knows which variables to fill.

aha_moments.user_pain: cxapi's requiredInputs omitted the header placeholder (hname), so a key variable had no input — it would never be personalized.
aha_moments.suggestion: Extract placeholders from the rendered preview, not just requiredInputs.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Every visible {{...}} is mappable — no silently-unfilled header variable.

aha_moments.user_pain: Typing a literal value per parameter is wrong for a bulk list (everyone would get the same text).
aha_moments.suggestion: Map each placeholder to a list column once; the send fills each recipient's own value.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Configure personalization in seconds, for the whole list, instead of per-contact.

aha_moments.user_pain: The channel dropdown showed a long phone/account code that means nothing to the operator.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Operator picks the channel by its human name, no code-noise.

aha_moments.user_pain: A single tall column made the modal long and the send-config felt bolted on under the identity fields.
aha_moments.suggestion: Two columns: identity+targets left, send-config right.
aha_moments.aha_moment: The whole project setup is visible at once without scrolling past unrelated fields.
